question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page and enter your email. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes.

question: How do I change my email address?
answer: Go to Settings > Account > Email, enter the new address and confirm using the code we send to it.

question: What plans and pricing do you offer?
answer: Free: 5 GB. Pro: $9/month for 100 GB. Team: $20/user/month for 1 TB shared storage.

question: Is there a free trial?
answer: Yes. Pro has a 14-day free trial and no credit card is required.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan. You keep access until the end of the current billing period.

question: What is your refund policy?
answer: We give a full refund if you ask within 14 days of your first purchase. After 14 days, payments are not refunded.

question: Which payment methods are accepted?
answer: Visa, Mastercard, UPI and PayPal. We do not accept cryptocurrency or cash.

question: Where can I download my invoices?
answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Invoices and download any invoice as a PDF.

question: What happens when I run out of storage?
answer: New uploads are blocked, but your existing files stay safe. Upgrade your plan or delete files to continue uploading.

question: What is the maximum file size I can upload?
answer: Free accounts can upload files up to 250 MB. Pro and Team accounts can upload files up to 2 GB.

question: Can I recover a deleted file?
answer: Yes. Deleted files stay in the Trash for 30 days and can be restored from there.

question: How do I share a file?
answer: Click the Share button on the file to create a link. Pro users can also add a password and an expiry date to the link.

question: How do I turn on two-factor authentication?
answer: Go to Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication and link an authenticator app. SMS codes are not supported.

question: Is my data encrypted?
answer: Yes. Files are encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.

question: Which devices and platforms are supported?
answer: Web, Windows, macOS, Android and iOS. There is no Linux desktop app at the moment.

question: Can I access my files offline?
answer: Yes, on the mobile apps. Mark a file as 'Available offline'. This feature is for Pro and Team plans.

question: How do I add team members?
answer: On the Team plan, open Admin console > Invite members. A team can have up to 50 members.

question: How do I contact support?
answer: Email support@cloudnest.example or use live chat Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm IST. We reply to emails within 24 hours.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Go to Settings > Account > Delete account. Deletion becomes permanent after a 14-day grace period.

question: My files are not syncing. What should I do?
answer: Pause and resume sync, check your internet connection, update the app, and if it still fails, sign out and sign in again.
